item.title: MORNING GLORY: Trump has restored the GOP as the party of defense and deterrence
item.summary: President Donald Trump announced a negotiation window as the U.S.-Iran conflict enters its fourth week, with the Iranian regime's military capacity argued to be severely degraded.

item.title: Trump’s Iran strategy showcases ‘doctrine of unpredictability’ amid strike threats and sudden pause
item.summary: Trump claims diplomatic progress paused U.S. strikes on Iran, but Tehran denies any talks, calling it "psychological warfare" as a five-day window continues.

item.title: Top House Dem dismisses probe into Jasmine Crockett’s security guard killed in SWAT standoff
item.summary: Rep. Pete Aguilar questioned whether Congress should probe Rep. Jasmine Crockett hiring a convicted criminal for her taxpayer-funded security detail.

item.title: Political traffic signals: waiting for the light to change on the Hill
item.summary: Congress faces a steep political battle over a $200 billion Iran war spending request, with Trump sending mixed signals on whether the funds are needed.

item.title: Wild GM Bill Guerin calls writer Jessi Pierce a 'ray of sunshine' after heartbreaking death involving her kids
item.summary: Minnesota Wild GM Bill Guerin called Jessi Pierce "a ray of sunshine" after the hockey writer and her three children died in a Minnesota house fire on Saturday.

item.title: Trump's death will be 'like Mardi Gras in New Orleans,' Charlamagne warns after Mueller post
item.summary: Radio host Charlamagne Tha God warned President Donald Trump that people will celebrate his death "like Mardi Gras" after he celebrated Robert Mueller's death.

item.summary: Megan Moroney hits the Bahamas for a friend's bachelorette trip and reveals she's covering Hannah Montana's 'Best of Both Worlds' for Spotify Singles.

item.title: Donald Trump’s legacy: Will Republicans embrace his political vision, or has he left conservatism in the dust?
item.summary: Is Trumpism a coherent ideology or gut impulse? Pete Wehner says MAGA has killed conservatism, but Trump's policy record tells a far more complex story.

item.title: Syracuse coach calls NCAA bracket placement a 'personal attack' after third straight tournament loss to UConn
item.summary: Syracuse women's basketball coach Felisha Legette-Jack said repeated UConn NCAA Tournament matchups feel like a "personal attack" after another blowout loss to the Huskies.
